serial.description: Select target by serial number (e.g., 0AA94EFD). Leave empty to auto-select.

storage.description: Set target storage type: emmc, nand, nvme, spinor, or ufs. Leave empty to let the tool auto-detect.

slot.description: Set slot number for multiple storage devices.

out_chunk_size.description: Override chunk size for transaction with device. 0 uses default.

dry_run.description: Dry run execution, no device reading or flashing.

allow_missing.description: Allow skipping of missing files during flashing.

skip_reset.description: Do not send the reset command after flashing completes.

backend.description: Select device backend: auto, usb, or qud.

skipblock.description: Use readback mechanism to skip program entries already on flash: none or sha256.

include_dir.description: Set an optional folder to search for files.

create_digests_dir.description: Generate table of digests in this folder.

vip_table_path.description: Use digest tables in this folder for VIP.

files.description: List of file paths to process (e.g., prog.mbn, program XML files). For a list-of-objects, use the 'items' schema in values_schema if complex structure is needed, but here simple strings are standard for qdl inputs.
